fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami’s tourist season and entertainment restrictions, criticizing law-enforcement actions affecting venues and dancing hours; discussion of local politics and civic institutions including the Miami Chamber of Commerce; columns on public safety and traffic/parking enforcement; commentary on receiverships and financial conditions; coverage touching on transportation conditions and segregation on streetcars/buses; and promotional/civic booster content including discussion of the opening of Florida’s Overseas Highway to Key West, alongside advertisements and humor/verse features.
